name: Broccoli, Apple & Bacon Salad with Walnuts
instructions: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Wash broccoli, carrots, and apples; set aside.
Place bacon in skillet and cook until crispy and golden, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Peel and mince garlic. In a large bowl, prepare salad dressing by whisking together garlic, lemon juice, mayo, honey, salt, and pepper.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces; add to bowl with dressing. Trim, peel, and coarsely grate carrots; add to bowl. Core and medium dice apples; add to bowl.
Add cranberries to bowl. Roughly chop walnuts and add to bowl.
Chop bacon into small pieces and add to salad. Toss salad until well coated with dressing.
Serve in a bowl and enjoy!
author: Mealime
